"While we are taking all steps necessary pursuant our constitutional duties as elected officials," Hutchinson continued during a news conference announcing his decision not to sign into law an earlier draft of Senate Bill 3-16-1400 ("Arkansas' Marriage Equality Amendment"), "there are certain sections in this measure which are blatantly discriminatory and others which I do not feel are sufficiently neutral."
